note: Light day, optional, 10 min max. 事 si6 ×3 → Hard-first batchim/café (7-sound rule, 밥, 옷, 주세요, 맛있어요) → recap Sat café lines → 7 new cards (둘/셋 and 한·두·세 개 주세요). Skip new if the 10 min is up. Skip if drained. 加油！

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (low, flat, no rise)

lines.translation: Hello. How much is it? · 你好。多少钱？
Two, please. Thank you. · 请给我两个。谢谢。
Three, please. Goodbye. · 请给我三个。再见。

tasks.prompt: Write ×3 then say: 둘 · 셋 · 두 개 주세요. If you have time, say 안녕하세요, 감사합니다 and 얼마예요 once each. Then one breath: Point → Reason → Example on why 둘 becomes 두 before 개.
tasks.script: Writing: 둘 둘 둘 · 셋 셋 셋 · 두 개 주세요 두 개 주세요 두 개 주세요. Optional: 안녕하세요. 감사합니다. 얼마예요? Explanation: Point: native numbers change form before the counter 개. Reason: 하나/둘/셋 shorten to 한/두/세 when a counter follows. Example: 둘 → 두 개 주세요 (two, please), not 둘 개 주세요.

questions.explain: Final ㅂ → p, so 밥 is bap. Recycle from the Tue/Fri weak spot.

questions.q: The final sound in 옷 and 셋 is…
questions.explain: ㅅ at the bottom of a block sounds like t: 옷 = ot, 셋 = set.
둘 becomes 두 before 개 → 두 개 주세요.

options: you are leaving and the other person stays
questions.explain: 가세요 = go. Say it when the other person is leaving. Hello = 안녕하세요.
